messages:
Jess: Hey @eng-platform -- can someone share the EU service overview + model-health dashboards shortlinks? I need to share with APAC infra. Getting a 403 when I open the old link: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd1234/model-overview :frowning:
Matt: Which 403? Grafana or Loki? Do you have the dashboard IDs? We tightened RBAC on the EU org recently.
Jess: Grafana 403. Dashboard names I have: `eu-service-overview` and `model-health-eu`.
Dana: @Jess added a shortlink alias for eu-service-overview: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/-/eu-svc-overview
Dana: That said, org RBAC still blocks view. Eng-platform, can you add jess (and the team @apac-infra) to view-only for org `eu-west-1`? Need it for on-call and runbook.
eng-platform: Hi! We can do this, but we require an IT self-service ticket for org membership changes (audit reasons). Quick workaround: add users to Okta group `grafana-eu-readers` and ping me. If you post the emails I can kick off the audit change.
Jess: Emails: jess@redwood.com, apac-infra@redwood.com. Also can we grant `sre` read access to `model-health-eu`? They're triaging alerts.
Matt: SRE group already has view on most dashboards, but model-health uses datasource `loki-eu` + tempo; you'll need tempo read for traces too. I'll double-check datasource permissions.
deploy-bot: Permission change audit: request received from eng-platform. Ticket #INC-2024-482 created.
oncall-sre: Quick tip: if you just need to share a snapshot, use the Grafana snapshot feature (top-right) — doesn't require org perms and is fine for runbooks (timebound).
eng-platform: Added jess@redwood.com to `grafana-eu-readers`. Please verify access and close ticket if OK. Also created alias for model-health: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/-/eu-model-health
Jess: Verified — I can see dashboards and traces now. Thanks! Closing ticket.
Matt: :thumbsup: I'll open a short PR to docs with the new aliases and the Okta group flow.
